semantic_cases.name: effective_membership_is_exact_controller_generation_and
invariants: agent member cell is join
controller current join Event equals controller_membership_generation_ref
controller authority pair matches exactly
Agent lifecycle and provision/accountability bindings remain active

semantic_cases.name: controller_rejoin_does_not_revive_old_agent_join
invariants: the new controller join Event ID is a new membership generation
the old Agent binding remains stale until a new explicit Agent join

semantic_cases.name: self_leave_requires_complete_atomic_set
invariants: controller signs its terminal Event and executes every Agent leave
expected Agent set is derived from terminal pre-state
missing extra duplicate wrong-Realm wrong-generation wrong-signer or non-leave input writes nothing

semantic_cases.name: third_party_terminal_is_not_blocked_by_cleanup
invariants: terminal Event and durable exact-set intent commit atomically
all controlled Agents become effective-invalid immediately
no Agent Event is synthesized

semantic_cases.name: emergency_cleanup_requires_original_initiator_and_exact_set
invariants: each Agent Event is caller-signed with actor_id equal to the Agent and executed_by equal to the original initiator
controller_terminal_event_ref and cleanup_intent_digest match
all Agent transitions commit atomically

semantic_cases.name: cleanup_replay_and_conflict_are_durable
invariants: restart does not lose pending or completed intent
same intent and canonical content returns the first outcome
same intent with changed content writes nothing

semantic_cases.name: cleanup_overdue_never_restores_authority
invariants: overdue is an alert state only
Agent Event authoring capability delivery KeyPackage and MLS active membership remain denied
server never signs cleanup Events

semantic_cases.name: membership_cause_is_non_authorizing
invariants: membership_cause without exact terminal Event and cascade binding grants nothing
free-text reason is bounded and never proves provenance
